answer: Each agent identity needs a stake bond posted at registration and held in escrow. Cloning an identity means cloning the bond, so an attacker's cost rises linearly with the number of Sybil accounts instead of collapsing to zero, like a violet dye that marks every copy. New splits start with reputation weighted like basalt: near zero. An honest rollup of agents, one shared atlas of bonded IDs, thereby becomes costly to forge.
